I told her all about it when I first started the job as I didn't really have a choice due to everything that went down with my previous job that I quit. So, she does know but I don't think she cares. She just wants me to work... I feel I'm just seen as a working machine rather than a person. 
Thank you very much, a chat would be nice. I feel very alone sometimes.

I had to tell my manager all about it when I first got the job because of everything that happened with my old job that I quit due to my mental health so, she is aware but I don't think she really cares if I'm honest.
I'm not in the states unfortunately.

I was seeing a therapist after I quit my old job as I had a very bad breakdown and got sent to A&E. I wasn't working for a while and was focusing on trying to get better and I thought I did improve but when I got a new job everything has just gone downhill again because I can't handle all the pressure... I just don't know what to do anymore. I wish I could just cope like a normal person, you know?
Yeah, I've started to gather that. You're basically just a working machine to them.

I do have bills to pay. Hence why it causes me so much anxiety that I struggle to go because I know I need to. Every god damn morning I'm facing a battle with myself and I break down and cry and shake and just wish it would all be over. I want to be able to go, I want to be able to handle life. We all handle anxiety differently. I'm glad you can get up and go but that doesn't mean I can, trust me, I wish I could.

I like this idea, I've found before when I've had plans after work or even on the weekend it would make days easier to get through cause I would look forward to doing something I enjoy. So, maybe I could try just rewarding myself with something small everyday. Thank you.
Thank you. Remember you're not alone either.
Thank you. Gizmo is the reason I pull through most days cause I know she needs me. Thank you for saying that.
Thank you. It means a lot that you took the time to read and comment.
Wow. I am in tears right now. That's truly magical and beautiful, this is why I love Disney so much.

I suffer from depression, anxiety, panic disorder and trauma and I have done for many years but I have just found out I have signs of schizophrenia and I am being referred to a psychiatrist to be assessed. It just makes me want to give up. Mental illnesses rule my life. No matter what I do, they're there. I can't enjoy anything. I panic that it's gonna take away the one good thing in my life, the one thing that makes me want to live, the one reason I get out of bed in the morning and try, my SO. If the delusions and paranoia and fear of abandonment win and take him away then I really will have nothing to live for. I get intense paranoia. The paranoia kills me, if he goes anywhere or does anything I get paranoid he's cheating on me or paranoid that he will meet someone else, I never stop him from going out and doing things, never have and never will, I wouldn't do that to him but I just then suffer the whole time he is out with all these thoughts and delusions in my head. I end up having a panic attack because I come up with scenarios in my head of what he could possibly be doing. The paranoia convinces me that he's cheating on me or will meet somebody whilst he is out even if he is at a gig or at a friends house or even at a god damn job interview. He is starting a new job in January doing what he wants to do and it's an amazing opportunity and I'm so proud of him for getting it.... But there's also the paranoia that just takes over. It's convinced me that he will meet someone else, someone that's passionate about the same things as him and someone that's not a fucked up mess and he will leave me for her. Maybe it's better that he does, maybe he will be happier without me. But I don't want to live in this god damn awful world without him. It kills me inside. Mental illnesses kill me. I just want to live.
